titles.title: เพื่อนบ้านประตูถัดไป

description:
Ko Ideum is a total shut in who knows how to do one thing, and one thing only: write passionate BL smut. There’s just one small problem: Ideum is a complete and total virgin. To try and stimulate his brain (among other things), Ideum takes to…well, “taking care of himself” in front of the window, imagining all sorts of sensual scenarios to jumpstart his creative juices. Sure, there may be an apartment right across from him, but nobody’s lived there for years…until now! Mid self-love session, he looks up to see a man staring at him from across the street - and not just any man, but the bisexual icon and surely soon-to-be celeb, acting major Kwon Jaeyi. Some might say their situation is a little too close for comfort…but maybe it’s just the right distance for something more.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/next_door)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/nicetoseeyou), [Spanish](https://www.lezhin.es/detail/vecinos-intimos), [French](https://www.lezhinfr.com/detail/bt_1111354), [German](https://www.lezhinde.com/detail/dbd_00547), [T.Chinese](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/close_neighbor), [Japanese](https://www.beltoon.jp/detail/chikasugiru_rinjin), [Thai](https://www.lezhinth.com/detail/neighbor_nextdoor)

##### Note: This series is a global release, meaning all official translations come out on the same day as the original Korean. All official translations are uncensored, except for Japanese.
